author: jsirish
name: local-ci
description: Run the executable test/lint layer locally — PHPUnit, PHPCS, PHPStan, npm lint/build/test, and Python ruff/pytest — auto-fixing where a fixer exists, then reporting pass/fail. Augments LLM code review, which never runs tests. Use when asked to run ci, run the tests, check before a PR, or verify a change before review or merge.
